entities.summary: Ramzan Akhmatovich Kadyrov is a Russian politician who is currently serving as the head of the Chechen Republic. He was formerly affiliated with the Chechen independence movement through his father, who was the separatist-appointed mufti of Chechnya. He is a colonel general in the Russian military. Ramzan Kadyrov was a military leaders & commanders from Akhmat-Yurt (b. 1976-10-05, Akhmat-Yurt). Relevant to geopolitics.
